scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix worker install
scripts.docker:db: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d mongodb redis
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.dev:worker: node init && npm --prefix worker run dev
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run docker:db
scripts.start: node init && npm run setup && npm run dev
